rationale: Adds a typed C++ API for custom WGSL passes on the shared Dawn device (pulp/render/gpu_pass.hpp, gpu_capabilities.hpp, wgsl_diagnostics.hpp), a build-time WGSL embed/validate helper, and moves the Renderer3D scene shader into a .wgsl file with a shared padded-row readback helper. Rendering output is unchanged: Renderer3D compiles the same shader text and its tests pass. The new API only adds objects on the existing device and composites through the existing SkiaCanvas native-texture seam. No design-import, Chromium, rendering-authority or packaging authority moves.
